crossRefs.note: These are those who served, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son…
So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were given cymbals of bronze to sound aloud;
Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and…
Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of…
All these were under the hands of their father for song in Yahweh’s house, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and…

people.name: Heman

people.name: Jeduthun

translations.web: and of the sons of Heman, Jehuel and Shimei; and of the sons of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.
translations.bsb: Jehiel and Shimei from the Hemanites; and Shemaiah and Uzziel from the Jeduthunites.
translations.kjv: And of the sons of Heman; Jehiel, and Shimei: and of the sons of Jeduthun; Shemaiah, and Uzziel.
